MS Norsky is a Finnish-flagged ro-ro cargo ferry built in 1999 by Aker Finnyards in Rauma, Finland, with an overall length of 180 meters, a beam of 25.5 meters, and a gross tonnage of 20,296 tons.[1][2] Owned by Bore Ltd of Helsinki, she is currently chartered to P&O Ferries and operates primarily on the Tilbury–Zeebrugge route, with additional services to Teesport and Rotterdam, carrying up to 11,400 deadweight tons of cargo across three decks with a total lane length of 2,630 meters.[1][2][3] Originally delivered to Bore Sky B.V.
